source: Give him oral rehydration solution after every loose stool.
translation: Mpe dawa ya kumuongezea maji kinywani kila anapopata kinyesi.
back_translation: Give him a mouthwash every time he has a bowel movement.

source: Give the child 5 ml of the syrup twice a day.
translation: Mpe mtoto 5 ml ya mchuzi mara mbili kwa siku.
back_translation: Give the child 5 ml of the broth twice a day.

source: After every loose stool, give him ORS to drink.
translation: Kila anapopata kinyesi kizito, mpe ORS anywe.
back_translation: Whenever he has a heavy stool, give him ORS to drink.
